days.title: Ninh Kieu – ancient house
days.morning: Arrive in Can Tho, visit Binh Thuy ancient house and Ong Pagoda.
days.afternoon: Phong Dien fruit orchards and Mekong bánh xèo.
days.evening: Stroll Ninh Kieu wharf and take a cruise with đờn ca tài tử music.

days.title: Cai Rang floating market
days.morning: Boat to Cai Rang floating market at 5 am and eat hủ tiếu on a boat.
days.afternoon: A traditional noodle workshop and My Khanh tourist village.
days.evening: Tay Do night market and fermented fish hotpot.

days.title: Son islet – Bang Lang stork garden
days.morning: Son islet – "flying" snakehead fish and folk cake making.
days.afternoon: Bang Lang stork garden with thousands of storks returning home.

days.title: Soc Trang – Khmer pagodas
days.morning: Soc Trang: Bat Pagoda and Chen Kieu Pagoda.
days.afternoon: Clay Pagoda, bún nước lèo and bánh pía cakes.

days.title: Chau Doc – Tra Su forest
days.morning: Head to An Giang for a boat ride in Tra Su cajuput forest.
days.afternoon: Ba Chua Xu temple and Sam Mountain.
days.evening: Chau Doc fish noodle soup and fermented fish gifts.
